//factory: Factory orchestration hooks. The installers (install.sh / install.ps1) rewrite __PYTHON__ and __HOOKS_DIR__ for this machine and MERGE this block into any existing settings.json (other keys preserved). On Windows the interpreter is 'py' (python3/python are dead Microsoft Store stubs); on POSIX it is python3. Hook paths are made ABSOLUTE because '~' is not reliably expanded in hook shells. The hook .py files carry a dirname==d root-walk guard so they cannot hang on a Windows drive root.

PreToolUse.//: Cred-leak guard: block a write/command containing a hardcoded secret.

PostToolUse.//: Burn-detection ratchet: feeds the regression dimension automatically.
Cost/observability log: append a per-turn record to factory-log.jsonl.

Stop.//: Deterministic line-loop: a build line cannot finish until its eval suite is green. Red routes failures back to the model; bounded by loop_max.

SubagentStop.//: Same loop gate for foreman child-line subagents - a delegated line is held to its eval suite exactly like a standalone one.

//routing: Factory routing policy - an orchestration PLACEHOLDER, not a native Claude Code setting. Nothing in the harness reads this block; it documents the intended model tiering (frontier for judgment, local for deterministic bulk). Enforce it through skills/prompts, not by expecting Claude Code to honor it.
